author: Delaney Vega
title: Bay High School hires new girls basketball coach - NewsBreak
text:
By Delaney Vega No media credit provided. ,
12 hours ago
PANAMA CITY, Fla. ( WMBB ) – Bay High School announced the hiring of Desmond Brown as its new head coach for girls basketball on Wednesday morning.
Coach Brown currently serves as the Head Coach for softball at Vernon High School and Assistant Coach for the boys basketball and football programs.
His resume also includes leading the Deane Bozeman High School girls’ basketball program for eight years. With the Bucks, Coach Brown logged 94 wins, led the program to three district runner-up finishes, and four playoff appearances.
In 2021, Coach Brown was named the FACA District 2-1A Coach of the Year.
School representatives say Coach Brown assumes Ty Steele’s position as Coach Steele stepped away to focus on his role as administrator at Bay High.
Bay Athletics released a statement:
“We are excited to welcome Coach Brown to Bay High!! Desmond is a proven leader who understands how to build a program the right way from developing fundamentals to creating a culture of accountability and toughness. His passion for student-athletes and commitment to growth made him the clear choice to lead our girls basketball program.”
“What stood out most throughout the process was his ability to connect with players and his vision for sustained success. We believe he will bring energy, structure, and a winning mindset to Bay.”
